definitions.explanation: A refined, sophisticated aesthetic sensibility associated with the aristocratic culture of the Heian period; the quality of being tasteful and cultured.

examples.japanese: {平安|へいあん}{時代|じだい}の{雅|みやび}を{感|かん}じる。
examples.english: I feel the elegance of the Heian period.

examples.japanese: {雅|みやび}な{歌|うた}の{世界|せかい}に{浸|ひた}った。
examples.english: I immersed myself in the refined world of poetry.

examples.japanese: {京都|きょうと}の{庭園|ていえん}には{雅|みやび}と{侘|わ}びが{共存|きょうぞん}している。
examples.english: In Kyoto gardens, courtly elegance and rustic simplicity coexist.

notes:
{雅|みやび} is a classical aesthetic concept central to Japanese culture.

HISTORICAL BACKGROUND:
{雅|みやび} was the aesthetic ideal of the Heian aristocracy (794-1185). It emphasized:
- Refined sensibility and taste
- Cultural accomplishment (poetry, music, calligraphy)
- Sophisticated emotional awareness
- Elegance in manners and appearance

ETYMOLOGY:
From {宮|みや} (palace, court) + び (suffix for manner/style), suggesting "in the manner of the court."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {雅|みやび}やか: elegant, refined (adjectival form)
- {雅|みやび}な{世界|せかい}: refined world
- {王朝|おうちょう}の{雅|みやび}: courtly elegance

RELATED AESTHETIC CONCEPTS:
- {侘|わ}び: rustic simplicity
- {寂|さ}び: patina of age
- {粋|いき}: urban chic
